description: This file implements an HTTP client with security features such as IP range checks, host/IP filtering, and proxy configuration for the Mattermost server.

methods.name: IsReservedIP
methods.description: Checks if an IP address belongs to reserved IP ranges to prevent SSRF attacks.

methods.name: IsOwnIP
methods.description: Determines if an IP address matches any of the host's network interfaces' IPs.

methods.name: dialContextFilter
methods.description: Wraps a dial function to enforce host and IP allowlist policies, providing detailed errors.

methods.name: getProxyFn
methods.description: Returns a function to determine proxy URL from environment, with IPv6 URL validation.

methods.name: NewTransport
methods.description: Creates a custom HTTP transport with security filters and optional insecure TLS settings.
